SELECT
    [Id] AS instructionId,
    [Version] AS version,
    [AccountId] AS accountId,
    [Status] AS status,
    [LetterOfAuthorization] AS letterOfAuthorization,
    [HolderRelationshipToAccount] AS holderRelationshipToAccount,
    [RailType] AS railType,
    [CustodialInstructionNumber] AS custodianInstructionNumber,
    [CreatedDate] AS createdDate,
    [UpdatedDate] AS updatedDate
FROM [dbo].[MoneyMovementInstruction]
WHERE [Id] = '{{instructionId}}'
